meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 它把 Slack 适配器从 channels 分支复制进项目并注册、安装 @chat-adapter/slack，然后带你创建 Slack 应用、把令牌写入 .env 并重启服务，让机器人能在 Slack 频道和私信里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Slack 添加为渠道时触发。若正处于 /setup 流程中，完成后回到该流程；否则用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 接线。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 Slack 渠道，用 Socket Mode。
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并引导配令牌。

say.text: 用 webhook 方式接入 Slack，帮我把凭据写进 .env。
say.note: 需要公网 HTTPS 地址指向 3000 端口。

say.text: 重启服务并跑一下 Slack 注册测试。

howto.what_en: It copies the Slack adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/slack@4.29.0, then guides you through creating a Slack app, saving tokens to .env and restarting the service so the bot sends and receives messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Slack as a channel. If you are in /setup, return to that flow afterward; otherwise wire the channel with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add Slack as a channel using Socket Mode.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, collects tokens.

say_en.text: Wire Slack over webhooks and store the credentials in .env.
say_en.note: Needs a public HTTPS URL pointing at port 3000.

say_en.text: Restart the service and run the Slack registration test.
